integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the commutative continuous functional calculus for a normal operator plus an exact scalar maximization. Sharpness is witnessed by one-dimensional scalar operators for every parameter value.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile is proved only for normal bounded operators. It does not improve the known general nonnormal stability exponent. Full text of the superseded arXiv:2609.10797v1 was not recoverable during comparison, so an equivalent special-case observation there remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp normal-operator stability for the approximate Fong–Tsui inequality
